offline: You're offline. Water you log is saved on this phone and syncs later.
infant: Babies under 6 months need only breast milk or formula, not water. Nothing to log here.
noTarget: No daily target yet. It is set when the family's profile is assessed.
aboveRange: That's more than twice the daily target. If this person is unusually thirsty, mention it to a clinician.

family.a11y: Family water today: {{score}} percent of targets
family.label: of today's targets

fastingWindow: Fasting now. Drink between iftar and suhoor.

timing.label: When
timing.hint: Water a little before a meal leaves room for food (the thirds).

guidance: Sip through the day. Most water is best a little before meals or between them, not in large amounts with food.
adab: Sunnah: drink sitting, in three breaths, and say Bismillah.
basis: Targets follow age, weight, activity and the season in your city.

symptoms.title: Signs of dehydration
symptoms.body: Tick anything you notice today. This is not a diagnosis.
symptoms.mild: Mild signs. Offer small sips often and keep an eye on them. If things get worse, speak to a clinician.
symptoms.none: No signs ticked. Keep drinking through the day.
symptoms.disclaimer: Thuluth is not a medical service. In an emergency call 1122 or go to the nearest hospital.

redFlag.title: Please get help
redFlag.emergency: These signs need urgent care now. Call 1122 or go to the nearest emergency department.
redFlag.youngChild: Young children dehydrate quickly. Contact a doctor today, and go to emergency if they get worse.
redFlag.sameDay: These signs need a clinician today. Give small sips of water or ORS while you arrange it.

breakFast.title: Break the fast
breakFast.body: Islam does not ask anyone to fast through signs like these. Break the fast now and drink. The day can be made up later.

clinician.title: Talk to a clinician
clinician.body: Tell them what you noticed, when it started, and what was eaten and drunk today.
